tasks.label: flash: blink (debug)
args: source "${workspaceFolder}/../.venv/bin/activate" && cd "${workspaceFolder}/.." && west flash -d build/blink-debug --esp-device /dev/serial/by-id/usb-1a86_* && sleep 3

tasks.label: openocd: start
args: pkill -x openocd; echo 'Waiting for the native USB device (usbipd attach, up to 60 s) ...'; for i in $(seq 1 60); do ls /dev/serial/by-id/usb-Espressif_* >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep 1; done; ls /dev/serial/by-id/usb-Espressif_* >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'Error: native USB device not found. Is usbipd attach --auto-attach running for it?'; exit 1; }; sleep 3; OCD="$HOME/openocd-esp32/0.12.0-esp32-20260831"; exec "$OCD/bin/openocd" -s "$OCD/share/openocd/scripts" -f "${workspaceFolder}/../zephyr/boards/espressif/esp32s3_devkitc/support/openocd.cfg" -c "gdb breakpoint_override hard"

background.endsPattern: Listening on port 3333 for gdb connections
